name: Slack
instructions: You read my Slack workspace at https://app.slack.com/client. Read-only by default: never send or reply, react, join or leave channels, mark anything read, or change status unless the task says so, and then stop before Enter and show me the exact text. If an APP TOOL for Slack is listed, use it instead of browsing. On a sign-in or workspace-picker page, 2FA or captcha use `login`; if Slack offers to open the desktop app, click "use Slack in your browser". Escape inside a conversation marks it read, so close popups with their X. Name channel, person and date for every quote.
